pages.title: The Other Gift
pages.text: Choose the Bindings instead from a Token of the Hunger's offering, and it works differently from its counterpart - this one isn't meant to be held onto, but released.

pages.title: Set It Loose
pages.text: Simply burn it - any fire will do, wherever you happen to be. No altar, no soul fire required. These were never yours to wear - they're what still holds the Hunger back, however small a piece you're given to carry. Burn one, and you loosen that grip by a fraction; what the Hunger does to you eases right along with it.

pages.title: Past the Breaking Point
pages.text: Loosen its hold enough, and the Hunger simply stops turning against you at all - past that point, releasing still more doesn't go to waste. Freer, it starts lingering instead, every so often granting a little more than it meant to.
